name: using-git-worktrees
tagline_zh: 开工新功能前，总怕弄乱现有代码？这个技能自动帮你开好隔离工作区，原生工具或 git worktree 兜底。
tagline_en: Starting new work? This skill auto-creates an isolated workspace via native tools or git worktree, so you can.
desc_en: Use when starting feature work that needs isolation from current workspace or before executing implementation plans - ensures an isolated workspace exists via native tools or git worktree fallback
why_zh: 同类技能只教命令，它却主动检查并创建隔离区，原生优先、worktree 兜底，省去手动步骤。
why_en: Unlike others that just list commands, it proactively checks and creates isolation, preferring native tools with worktree.
